# turbos7 (vendored source)

This directory contains the `turbos7` 0.2.1 source snapshot used by `s7trace`.
The crate provides an asynchronous ISO-on-TCP client for Siemens S7 PLCs.

The repository URL recorded in the published crate metadata is no longer
available. `s7trace` therefore builds from this reviewed in-tree copy through
the `[patch.crates-io]` entry in the root `Cargo.toml`.

Local fixes and their verification notes are documented in
[`FORK-PATCH-NOTES.md`](FORK-PATCH-NOTES.md).
